copyButtonUserTurn.description: Copy button (icon-only, this is its tooltip) above one of the user’s own messages; copies its text

copyButtonAssistantTurn.description: Copy button (icon-only, this is its tooltip) above an assistant reply; copies its text

copyButtonThinkingBlock.description: Copy button (icon-only, this is its tooltip) above the model’s reasoning / thinking section; copies its text

copyButtonCodeBlock.description: Copy button (icon-only, this is its tooltip) above a code block; copies its text

copyButtonCopied.description: Toast after the copy button put the text on the clipboard

copyButtonFailed.description: Toast when the copy button could not write the text to the clipboard
